MRRP Lab Pets


Fred
Human: Alex
Adopted on: 2022-06-09

Fred loves looking out the window at his new home in Bellingham. His asthma has gotten much better since moving from Colorado, where he was born in the height of the 2020 wildfire season. Perhaps because he was born during the pandemic lockdown, he very much dislikes having guests at home, but he is a sweet cuddly boy once you get to know him.
